analysis.title: Block Inc. 3Q26 Expectations Summary - We Remain Constructive
key_insights: JPM stays constructive on Block (XYZ) into earnings on 11/3 after the close. Spending data points to largely stable growth, and XYZ described July and August spending growth trends as stable.
Cash App Borrow is moving from a 4-week product at ~5% pricing to a 6-week product at 7.5%. JPM expects this to give Block tools to support gross profit upside into 2027.

JPM expects Borrow losses to rise as a % of originations because of the longer duration, but by less than the pricing change. The effect is non-linear and should add to adj. operating profit and likely gross profit.

JPM's model update expects lower Borrow originations, slightly higher gross profit, higher losses as a % of originations and higher variable profit. 2H26 gross profit and adj. operating profit rise modestly and FY27 is largely unchanged.

JPM's Transaction and Loan Losses estimate for 3Q is ~$580M against Street at $560M. JPM acknowledges a wide range of outcomes depending on origination trends, and says Block can raise limits to drive gross profit if it chooses.
JPM has greater conviction that Block can reach a mid-teens gross profit growth exit rate in 4Q following the Borrow pricing changes, which should support momentum into 1H27.
3Q26 JPMe and Street estimates are broadly in line with guidance: gross profit growth of 18% and adj. operating margin of 28%, implying a Rule of 40 of 46%.
Consensus expects ~12% Square GPV growth in 3Q26, a modest deceleration from +13.4% reported in 2Q26. JPMe is at 13% (US +10%, non-US +27%).
Block has occasionally given preliminary year-ahead expectations at its 3Q results. JPMe and Street assume FY27 gross profit growth of 15% and adj. operating margin of 31%.
JPM's FY27 adj. EPS estimate of $5.46 (+34%) is ahead of Street at $5.25 (+30%).

Consensus is broadly in line with implied 4Q26 guidance, and adj. EPS is $0.02 above it. JPM's estimates show modest upside to implied gross profit, adj. operating profit and adj. EPS in 4Q, partly from the Borrow change.

JPM reiterates Overweight and a $110 Dec-27 price target (A$156 for the ASX line). The target applies ~16x CY28E adj. EPS, a discount to the three-year average NTM multiple of ~19x. The current multiple is 15x.
JPM points to improved product velocity, including Square Kiosks, Dessa and Buzz.

market_movers.rationale: JPM stays constructive into 11/3 earnings. The Borrow pricing change supports gross profit upside into 2027 and a mid-teens gross profit growth exit rate in 4Q.

earnings_insights: Block reports 3Q26 on Tuesday 11/3 after the close.
3Q26 total gross profit: JPMe $3,136M (+18% y/y), Street $3,154M (+18%), company guidance $3,130M (+18%). These are estimates, not reported results.
3Q26 adj. operating profit: JPMe $878M, Street $880M, guidance $875M. Adj. operating margin is 28% on all three.
3Q26 adj. EPS: JPMe $1.04 (+93% y/y), Street $1.02 (+89%), guidance $1.02 (+89%). All are estimates.
3Q26 Cash App gross profit: JPMe $1,950M (+20%), Street $1,970M (+21%). Square gross profit: JPMe $1,151M (+13%), Street $1,157M (+14%).
FY26 estimates: total gross profit JPMe $12,551M (+21%), Street $12,536M, guidance $12,510M. Adj. EPS is JPMe $4.08 (+71%), Street $4.04, guidance $4.02.
FY26 adj. operating profit: JPMe $3,492M, Street $3,472M, guidance $3,470M. Adj. operating margin is 28% on all three.

Implied 4Q26 guidance (derived from the full year, 3Q guidance and YTD results): gross profit $3,310M, adj. operating profit $1,000M, adj. EPS $1.13. Estimates are JPMe $3,340M / $1,023M / $1.17 and Street $3,307M / $1,000M / $1.15.

FY27 estimates: gross profit JPMe $14,457M (+15%) vs Street $14,404M (+15%). Adj. operating profit is JPMe $4,490M vs Street $4,457M. Cash App gross profit is JPMe $9,270M (+16%) vs Street $9,322M (+17%). Square gross profit is JPMe $5,018M (+13%) vs Street $4,986M (+12%).

JPM estimate changes: FY26 Cash App gross profit rises 0.5% to $7,986M and FY26 adj. operating profit rises 0.6% to $3,495M. FY27 adj. operating profit falls 0.3% to $4,495M and FY27 total gross profit falls 0.1% to $14,467M.
Already reported, 2Q26: adj. EPS $1.02, gross profit $3,166M, adj. operating profit $864M, Square GPV growth +13.4%. 1Q26: adj. EPS $0.85, gross profit $2,909M.
crypto_views: The risk section flags a significant devaluation of major cryptocurrencies, notably bitcoin, as a threat to Cash App user engagement. Crypto regulation could limit Block's ability to monetize crypto investments.
risk_factors: Macro slowdown could pressure Square GPV growth, raise bankruptcies and weigh on Cash App card spending volume.
Slower adoption of Square's value-added services, including Banking products.
A downturn in the small business credit cycle, inability to fund merchant cash advances, or higher losses on consumer lending originations.
Net margin compression for Square from competition or pricing pressure from larger SMBs.
Significant devaluation of bitcoin and other major cryptocurrencies, or adverse crypto regulation.
Key person risk tied to CEO and co-founder Jack Dorsey.
Borrow losses could rise more than expected with the longer duration, and the range of outcomes is wide depending on origination trends.

tension_points.bull_case: Moving to 6 weeks at 7.5% from 4 weeks at ~5% is neutral to notably accretive to gross profit, lifts Borrow adj. operating income net of losses, and supports a mid-teens gross profit growth exit rate in 4Q.
tension_points.bear_case: Borrow originations fall, and losses as a % of originations rise because of the longer duration. JPM acknowledges a wide range of outcomes depending on origination trends.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Losses rising by more than the pricing change, or originations falling enough to cut gross profit. JPM names no specific numeric level.

theme_stances.key_argument: The 6-week, 7.5% Borrow structure gives Block tools to support gross profit upside into 2027, with higher losses as a % of originations but accretion to adj. operating profit.
theme_stances.evidence: changes to Cash App Borrow terms
